description: Starts a request for the signed-in person. Needs what they need, where (City, ST), and their consent. Returns a requestId. If CAR is not sure what kind of business it needs, it answers needs_detail with a question and choices and sends nothing; a repeat call with category set to one of those choices goes ahead. Status verify_person means the person was texted a 6-digit code, which car_confirm_person checks. No business is contacted before that.

budget.description: Budget, if the person gave one

category.description: Optional. A category slug from /v1/categories that the person picked, for example after a needs_detail question. Without it, CAR reads the request.

consent.description: The person agreed to be contacted by one matched business and by CAR about this request

phone.description: US mobile number to text the confirmation code to. Defaults to the signed-in number.

estimateId.description: An estimateId from car_get_estimate: the business gets the same scope and planning range

idempotencyKey.description: 8-64 letters, digits, _ or -. A repeat with the same key returns the same request

name.description: First name the business can ask for

size.description: Size of the job, e.g. "40 guests", "3 bedrooms"

what.description: What the person needs, in their own words. This text goes to the matched business, so it holds no health details, ID numbers, card numbers or passwords.

when.description: asap, this_week, flexible, or a date (YYYY-MM-DD)

where.description: City and two-letter US state, e.g. "Tampa, FL" (a ZIP may follow)

name: car_send_request
title: Send a request to one checked business
